summary: Built the after-save record-triggered Flow Case_Escalation_Notify_Account_Owner (Case, Update, IsEscalated transitions to true) that emails the related Account's Owner with the Case Number and Subject, with an explicit no-Account skip-and-log path, a Queue-owned-Account fallback to a Support Manager address, and a mutually-backstopped fault-logging chain writing Application_Log__c and notifying an admin address on any failure. Emitted 1 Flow, 1 package.xml, 1 deploy-order.md under artefacts/M1-S01/. Both cited checkers were run for real: check_record_triggered_flow_patterns.py exited 0 ('No issues found.'); check-outputs confirmed all 3 declared outputs exist, are non-empty, and the two XML files parse.
confidence_rationale: Every emitted element traces to a cited skill's own worked example (the entry-criteria/fault-connector shape from flow/record-triggered-flow-patterns, the emailSimple actionCalls parameter names from admin/flow-for-admins Example 2), the cited checker exited 0 on the first pass with no repair needed, check-outputs returned ok, every declared output was written and nothing else was, and every Questions-to-Ask row the step's inputs.answers carries was answered from the plan rather than defaulted silently by this agent.

process_observations.observation: The step's inputs.emailSimple_action_shape already named the exact source (admin/flow-for-admins Example 2) and parameter names to use, so this build step required no independent re-derivation of the emailSimple shape -- the plan-verifier's grounding fix carried through cleanly to the build.

This build assumes Application_Log__c already exists in the target org; it does not create it. Both recordCreates elements that write to it (Log_Skip_No_Account, Create_Application_Log_Error) will fail identically if it does not exist, falling through to the fault chain's own failure path. Named in deploy-order.md's pre-deploy checklist rather than built as a dependency, since no step in this plan owns creating that object.
Artefacts built and check-outputs is ok; the step is ready for the tester.
